notes.content: [p]Finally![/p][p]It took quite a lot longer than I initially planned, but it's finally here![/p][p]Despite the odd version number, this is a full update (Yes it's gotten that big):[/p][p][/p][p]- a little under 1000 render[/p][p]- 24 animations[/p][p]- fixed several issues with the gallery and I'm still working on expanding it's functionality[/p][p]- fixed issues with the naming option in the settings[/p][p]- added an option for how Jada calls the MC in game, so you can change it whenever you want[/p][p]- fixed and/or reworked parts of a few older scenes[/p][p][/p][p]Finally I'm sad to say that I didn't get much feedback during the beta, so if you encounter any problems, bugs, typos, or something weird, etc., please let me know and I'll have a look at it.[/p][p]Also, have fun and I hope you enjoy the new content :D[/p]

notes.title: Update 0.8.5; QOL improvements and more!
notes.content:
Hey there lovely people ;)

Here's a little update with just one new scene, but a lot of technical improvements.
Be sure to check the Settings/Preferences.
Also, if you want to see the full new scene, you need to be on the harem route, and on Jada' and Rachel's route.

Here's the Changelog for v0.8.5:

- 171 Render
- 10 Animations
- fixed the Gallery
- added new scenes from 0.8+ to the gallery
- reworked the Settings (aka preferences) menu
- added some QOL settings (see the settings menu)
- general QOL improvements
- fixed some code issues
- added italian and french languages (fan translated!!). Currently at 0.8, not updated to 0.8.5, yet, e.g. the last scene is not translated!

Have fun, and let me know what you think about the improvements (and the scene *wink*).

notes.title: Update 0.8 is finalle here!
notes.content:
It took a lot longer than expected, but if you followed the News on here, you'll know that my RL got in the way.
I know some people were eagerly waiting for the update, so sorry again for the long delay.

Anyway, here are the Details/the Changelog for the update:

- there are 972 new Render
- 27 new animations
- I've made some major code changes/improvements
- this time it's a more story focused update, but there are still some (new) naughty bits
- aside from the main story, there's also a pretty long and hot scene with Steph (the co-worker), and I can [b]really[/b] only recommend to go for it, even if you didn't pursue her, yet.
- Improved and corrected some older scenes, including renders and dialogues
- changed the map layout somewhat to make room for future scenes/places
- Gallery update will come at a later point, I haven't added the new scenes, yet.

That's it so far. Saves from the last update should work, but I had some trouble with saves specifically from (ingame) day 11, day 12 and pre- day 11 saves worked though, as long as they're not too old (several updates behind).

Alright, that's it, have fun playing, enjoy!

notes.title: This thing on?
notes.content:
First things first:
[h3][b]A big Thank you to everyone who supported and still supports me here on Steam and everywhere else![/b][/h3]
Also thanks to everyone for taking part in the community and for all the positive feedback so far!

The release went quite smooth, no big surprises here, but a few people seem to have a problem with the animations not running smoothly, this seems to be a renpy issue (the engine I'm using) and will be fixed with the next release. If you don't want to work that long, there is a workaround that seems to work for most players:
Open the game, hit Shift + G, in the new window turn off "Power Saving" and turn on "Force ANGLE2 Renderer", disable Tearing if it's enabled, that's it.
As I said, this works for most people, but some had to switch to another renderer and for some people nothing worked at all, they'll sadly have to wait for the update :(

I've read a few comments from people being concerned about Ellie's look, so first thing I'd like to mention is that she's definitley 18 and also meant to look like that (while also meant to look extremely cute), if you think she looks too young then I'd suggest to go out and see a few 18 y.o. girls, and I don't mean these girls with 20tons paint on their faces, you might notice that some look younger than others, while some also look older, my niece for example is 22 and looks younger than Ellie.

Then there are some people complaining about the game being too short...
I mean... I don't know, did you see the "Early Access" tag? Also seeing some barely even reached 2 hours play time, did you try other routes? I know that not every route is for everyone, so no offense, but if you don't follow Kat's and/or Jada's route for example, then you miss a lot content.

Regarding the update I can't give a date yet, I want to have a specific amount of content ready before I release it, I'm also awaiting some new hardware that should speed things up, but it also makes it harder to predict any date.
I'm hoping to be able to release the update within the next two months.
On the technical side there's a lot of the stuff meant for the update already exclusively in the steam version, but there will some more coming. One example is changeable in-game music.
A russian and a portuguese fan-translation are on the way as well.
Of course there will be new content, the story will progress, we will finally be able to date Hanna, get closer to Rachel, and there might also be a big surprise... :P

Well, that's it for now, thanks for your attention.

Don't forget that you can join my [url=https://discord.gg/QkrKJTt]discord[/url] if you want to get latest news, teasers and update status of Bad Memories, or if you just want to take part in the community. There's also some extra stuff for patrons/subscriber ;)

Have a good one!
~rec
